HERO.TITLE: Hi, I'm Yago 👋
HERO.ROLE: Backend Software Developer · NestJS · SQL · REST APIs · Docker
HERO.DESCRIPTION: I build backend services and REST APIs for enterprise fintech and international payment infrastructure at Silice. I work mostly with Java, NestJS and SQL databases, and I care about clean, maintainable code. Outside of work I build things with Angular and Spring Boot, and I keep an eye on distributed systems, Arduino and robotics.

ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_1: I'm a full stack software developer at Silice España, where I contribute to enterprise fintech solutions and international payment infrastructure. Day to day that means designing backend services, building and maintaining REST APIs, and working with SQL databases and payment workflows alongside an agile team.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_2: I trained as a Higher Technician in Web Application Development at IES Castelar, won Extremadura Skills 2025 in the Web Development category, and went on to compete as a finalist at SpainSkills 2026. Competing taught me as much as any classroom did: how to work under real time pressure and how to ship something that actually holds up.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_3: Outside of work I build personal projects with Angular, Spring Boot and cloud services, and I enjoy learning about distributed systems, Arduino and robotics.

SUBTITLER.TITLE: Subtitler: Live
SUBTITLER.DESCRIPTION: Live content platforms like Twitch, Kick and YouTube still fall short on accessibility, so I built Subtitler: Live as my final project for the Higher Technician in Web Application Development. It captures the audio of a browser tab the user selects, sends fragments to AWS S3 every few seconds, and returns near real-time subtitles through Amazon Transcribe — aimed at people with hearing impairments, and at talks and conferences with no budget for interpreters.
